identity.name: Westlake
identity.hoa_name: Westlake Residences Master HOA (West Lake Homeowners Association, Inc.)
identity.notes: Westlake is a 3,800-acre master-planned community and incorporated city (2016) in Westlake, FL 33470, in the heart of Palm Beach County. Developed by Minto Communities, it offers 3-4 bedroom townhomes (Courtyard Collection) and 2-6 bedroom single-family and luxury estate homes. Governed by the Westlake Residences Master HOA managed by Vesta Property Services (16290 Town Center Parkway North), the community features the 15-acre Westlake Adventure Park as its centerpiece. Sub-neighborhoods include Terraces of Westlake, Hammocks of Westlake, and Orchards of Westlake. Convenient access to I-95 and the Florida Turnpike provides connections to beaches, recreation, and airports across Palm Beach County and South Florida.

fees.note: No CDD fees; advertised as a key buyer savings feature by developer Minto Communities. Multiple sub-sources confirm zero CDD assessments for Westlake properties. Confidence 0.8 (developer official listing).

HOA fees described as 'low' with general reported ranges of approximately $100–$400/month depending on sub-association (e.g., Terraces, Hammocks, Orchards). No uniform master fee published; amounts vary by neighborhood and property type. Confidence 0.5 (aggregated secondary source, no primary HOA document).

fees.note: Real estate listings indicate quarterly HOA fees around $313–$323 specifically for the Terraces of Westlake townhome sub-association. Other sub-HOAs may differ. Confidence 0.55 (secondary real-estate listing data, not HOA-verified).

amenities.detail: Centerpiece pool at the 15-acre Westlake Adventure Park; resort-style lagoon pool with a tower slide, described as the primary swimming amenity for all residents.
Dedicated adult lap pool within Westlake Adventure Park, separate from the family lagoon pool.
Water play feature for children located in the Westlake Adventure Park area.
Large adventure playground within Westlake Adventure Park; additional playgrounds may exist in sub-neighborhoods.
Dedicated BMX pump park in Westlake Adventure Park for cycling and action sports.
Outdoor basketball courts in Westlake Adventure Park; additional courts may be available in sub-neighborhoods.
Dedicated dog park (Paw Park) with green space, accessible to residents; a separate large park with green space and a dog park is also mentioned.
Outdoor bocce courts in the Westlake Adventure Park / community park area.
Covered pavilion for concerts, events, and gatherings within the community parks.
Large event lawns in Westlake Adventure Park for community gatherings, festivals, and private events.
Dedicated food truck court within the community for on-site dining and social gatherings.
The Lodge — a clubhouse/social venue within the Westlake Adventure Park complex, used for events and resident gatherings.
Concession stands at Westlake Adventure Park for food, beverages, and poolside refreshments.
Walking paths and trails throughout the 3,800-acre community and park areas, including a large green-space park.
Large park with ample green space maintained by the master association across the 3,800-acre development.
State-of-the-art sales center with interactive display, café, children's playroom, and interior design center (developer-operated; primarily for homebuyers).
